description: This is a PHP unit test class for testing the ClaimDao's expense type data access methods within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It includes setup routines and multiple test cases for retrieving, deleting, and checking usage of expense types related to claims.

classes.name: ClaimDaoExpenseTypeTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing ClaimDao expense type functions.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, instantiates ClaimDao, and loads fixture data.

methods.name: testGetExpenseTypeList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a list of expense types based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetExpenseTypeById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a specific expense type by its ID.

methods.name: testDeleteExpenseType
methods.description: Tests deletion of specified expense types by their IDs.

methods.name: testIsExpenseTypeUsed
methods.description: Checks whether a specific expense type is in use.
